summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its 2026 Annual General and Special Meeting to be held virtually on June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine meeting notice and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms, stakeholder actions, or strategic changes are disclosed. The filing is administrative in nature and not a special-situation event.
